paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter using solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance
notes: CASPEr solid-state NMR search for axion-like dark matter via EDM coupling g_d (and gradient coupling g_aNN). The g_d limit corresponds to oscillating neutron EDM amplitude < 1.0e-21 e*cm over mass range 162-166 neV (39.1-40.2 MHz). Limit reported as |g_d|<9.5e-4 GeV^-2, equivalently d_n < 1.0e-21 e*cm. Only flat representative endpoints from text given; full curve in Fig 3(a) not numerically available. DM density rho_DM = 3.6e-42 GeV^4 ~ 0.4 GeV/cm^3 standard halo assumed.
